units.zh: 列傳八十七
units.en: Biographies 87
units.literal: Biographies eighty-seven.

units.zh: 沈起元何師儉唐繼祖馬維翰餘甸王葉滋劉而位
units.en: Shen Qiyuan, He Shijian, Tang Jizu, Ma Weihan, Yu Dian, Wang Yezi, and Liu Erwei
units.literal: Shen Qiyuan, He Shijian, Tang Jizu, Ma Weihan, Yu Dian, Wang Yezi, Liu Erwei.

units.zh: 沈起元，字子大，江南太倉人。
units.en: Shen Qiyuan, whose courtesy name was Zida, came from Taicang in Jiangnan.
units.literal: Shen Qiyuan, courtesy name Zida, was a man of Taicang in Jiangnan.

units.zh: 康熙六十年進士，選庶吉士，改吏部主事。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in the sixtieth year of the Kangxi reign, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was then appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: In the sixtieth year of Kangxi he passed the jinshi examination, was chosen as a Hanlin bachelor, and was transferred to be a principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 擢員外郎，以知府發福建用。
units.en: Promoted to vice department director, he was sent to Fujian to serve as a prefect.
units.literal: He was promoted to vice department director and was dispatched to Fujian for appointment as prefect.

units.zh: 總督高其倬令權福州，調興化。
units.en: Governor Gao Qisuo placed him in charge of Fuzhou as acting prefect, then moved him to Xinghua.
units.literal: Governor Gao Qisuo had him act as prefect of Fuzhou and transferred him to Xinghua.

units.zh: 時世宗聞福建倉穀虧空，遣廣東巡撫楊文乾等往按，被劾者半，受代者爭為煩苛，起元獨持平。
units.en: When the Yongzheng Emperor learned that Fujian's granary accounts showed large shortfalls, he sent Guangdong governor Yang Wenqian and others to investigate. Half of those investigated were impeached, and their successors competed to be harsh and troublesome—only Qiyuan remained fair and even-handed.
units.literal: At that time the Yongzheng Emperor, hearing that Fujian's granary grain was in deficit, sent Guangdong Governor Yang Wenqian and others to investigate; half of those impeached [were found guilty], and those who succeeded them vied to be vexatious and harsh, but Qiyuan alone held to the middle course.

units.zh: 莆田民因訟互鬥，其倬恐釀亂，令捕治。
units.en: The people of Putian had come to blows over lawsuits, and Qisuo, fearing unrest, ordered them rounded up.
units.literal: The people of Putian fought one another in the course of litigation, and Qisuo, fearing disorder, ordered arrests.

units.zh: 起元責兩人而釋其餘，報曰：「罪在主者，餘不足問也。」
units.en: Qiyuan punished the two ringleaders and released the others, reporting: "The offense rests with the leaders; the rest do not warrant inquiry."
units.literal: Qiyuan held two responsible and released the rest, reporting: "The guilt lies with the principals; the rest need not be questioned."

units.zh: 尋攝海關，裁陋規萬餘金。
units.en: He was soon put in charge of the maritime customs and eliminated irregular levies amounting to more than ten thousand taels.
units.literal: Soon he was placed in charge of the customs house and cut shabby fees by more than ten thousand taels.

units.zh: 巡撫常安有奴在關，以索費困商舶。
units.en: Governor Chang An kept a servant at the customs who extorted merchants and impeded their ships.
units.literal: Governor Chang An had a slave at the customs who harassed merchant vessels by demanding fees.

units.zh: 起元聞，立督收稅如額，令商舶行，白常安斥奴。
units.en: On hearing this, Qiyuan at once enforced full tax collection, allowed the merchant fleet to sail, and reported to Chang An to have the servant expelled.
units.literal: When Qiyuan heard of it, he immediately supervised tax collection to the full quota, let merchant vessels proceed, and informed Chang An to dismiss the slave.

units.zh: 自是人皆奉法。
units.en: After that, all conformed to the regulations.
units.literal: From then on everyone obeyed the law.

units.zh: 其倬奏開南洋，報可。
units.en: Qisuo memorialized to reopen trade with the Southern Seas, and the court approved.
units.literal: Qisuo memorialized to open the Southern Seas; approval was granted.

units.zh: 已，復令商出洋者，必戚里具狀，限期返，逾者連坐。
units.en: Before long, however, a new order required merchants sailing abroad to obtain affidavits from kinsmen, with fixed deadlines for return—those who missed the deadline would bring collective punishment on their families.
units.literal: Soon afterward it was again ordered that merchants going to sea must have relatives provide bonds, with a fixed time limit for return; those who exceeded it would be punished by association.

units.zh: 起元曰：「人之生死，貨之利鈍，皆無常，戚里豈能預料？
units.en: Qiyuan objected: "Whether a man lives or dies, whether goods prosper or fail—all is unforeseeable. How can relatives predict such outcomes?
units.literal: Qiyuan said: "Life and death of men, profit and loss of goods—all are uncertain; how can kinsmen anticipate them?

units.zh: 且始不聽出洋則已，今聽之，商造船集貨費不貲，奈何忽撓以結狀？
units.en: Besides, if going to sea were still forbidden, that would be one thing; but now that it is allowed, merchants have spent fortunes fitting out ships and assembling cargo—why suddenly burden them with bond requirements?
units.literal: Moreover, if you will not allow going to sea, fine; but now that it is permitted, merchants spend untold sums building ships and gathering cargo—how can you suddenly trouble them with bonds?

units.zh: 若令商自具狀，過三年不歸，勿聽回籍，不猶愈乎？」
units.en: If merchants filed their own bonds, and those who failed to return within three years were barred from re-registering in their home districts, would that not serve better?"
units.literal: If merchants themselves provide bonds, and if they do not return within three years they are not heard for household registration, would that not be better?"

units.zh: 其倬從之。
units.en: Qisuo adopted his proposal.
units.literal: Qisuo followed his advice.

units.zh: 調台灣。
units.en: He was transferred to Taiwan.
units.literal: He was transferred to Taiwan.

units.zh: 台灣田一甲準十一畝有奇，賦三則：上則一甲穀八石，中則六石，下則四石，視內地數倍。
units.en: In Taiwan one jia of land equaled a little over eleven mu; tax fell into three tiers—upper-grade land paid eight dan of grain per jia, middle-grade six dan, and lower-grade four dan, several times the rates in the interior provinces.
units.literal: Taiwan's land reckoning: one jia equals slightly more than eleven mu; tax has three grades—upper grade one jia eight dan of grain, middle six dan, lower four dan—several times those of the interior.

units.zh: 然多隱佔，民不甚困。
units.en: Much land, however, was concealed or illegally occupied, so the burden on the people had not been severe.
units.literal: Yet much was concealed and encroached upon, so the people were not greatly pressed.

units.zh: 時方清丈，佔者不得匿。
units.en: A full land survey was then under way, and those who had hidden holdings could no longer conceal them.
units.literal: At that time a comprehensive land survey was underway, and occupiers could no longer hide.

units.zh: 其倬欲使台灣賦悉視內地下則，恐不及額致部詰。
units.en: Qisuo wanted to reduce all Taiwan assessments to the interior lower-grade rate, fearing ministry censure if revenues fell short.
units.literal: Qisuo wished to make all Taiwan taxes equal to the interior lower grade, fearing that failure to meet quotas would bring reprimands from the ministry.

units.zh: 起元令著籍者仍舊額，丈出者視內地下則。
units.en: Qiyuan ruled that land already on the registers should keep its old assessment, while newly measured holdings would be taxed at the interior lower grade.
units.literal: Qiyuan ordered that those already registered should keep their old quotas, while newly surveyed land should be taxed at the interior lower grade.

units.zh: 俟隱佔既清，更減舊額重者均於新額，賦不虧而民無累。
units.en: Once hidden encroachments were cleared, heavy old assessments would be lightened and spread across the new totals, preserving revenue without crushing the people.
units.literal: When concealed occupation was cleared, heavier old quotas would be reduced and averaged into the new assessments, so revenue would not suffer and the people would not be overburdened.

units.zh: 起元在福州，以辨冤獄忤按察使潘體豐，體豐中以他事，鐫四級，遂告歸。
units.en: In Fuzhou he had offended judicial intendant Pan Tifeng by righting a wrongful conviction; Tifeng found another pretext to demote him four ranks, and Qiyuan then resigned and went home.
units.literal: While in Fuzhou, in exonerating a wrongful case he offended Judicial Intendant Pan Tifeng; Tifeng struck at him on other grounds and demoted him four ranks, whereupon he retired home.

units.zh: 高宗即位，起江西驛鹽道副使。
units.en: When the Qianlong Emperor took the throne, Qiyuan was recalled as vice commissioner of the Jiangxi courier-and-salt circuit.
units.literal: When the Gaozong Emperor acceded, [Qiyuan] was recalled as vice commissioner of the Jiangxi courier and salt circuit.

units.zh: 乾隆二年，擢河南按察使。
units.en: In Qianlong 2 he was promoted to judicial commissioner of Henan.
units.literal: In the second year of Qianlong he was promoted to Henan judicial commissioner.

units.zh: 會久雨，被災者四十餘縣，饑民四走，或議禁之。
units.en: Prolonged rains had flooded more than forty counties, and starving refugees scattered in every direction—some officials proposed barring their movement.
units.literal: There had been long rains; more than forty counties suffered disaster, and starving people fled in all directions; some proposed to forbid their movement.

units.zh: 起元謂：「民飢且死，奈何止其他徙？」
units.en: Qiyuan protested: "The people are starving to death—how can you block them from seeking refuge elsewhere?"
units.literal: Qiyuan said: "The people are starving and near death—how can you stop them from fleeing elsewhere?"

units.zh: 令安置未被水諸縣，給以糧，遂無出河南境者。
units.en: He had them settled in counties untouched by flood and issued grain rations, so that none left the province.
units.literal: He ordered them settled in counties not flooded, provided grain, and thus none left Henan.

units.zh: 巡撫雅爾圖檄府縣修書院，以起元總其事，乃教群士省身克己之學。
units.en: Governor Yartu directed local governments to restore academies and placed Qiyuan in overall charge; he instructed the scholars in the discipline of inward scrutiny and moral self-restraint.
units.literal: Governor Yartu ordered prefectures and counties to repair academies and put Qiyuan in charge; he then taught the scholars the learning of self-examination and self-restraint.

units.zh: 立章善坊，書孝子、悌弟、義夫、貞婦名，採訪事實，為章善錄版行，一時風動。
units.en: He founded a Zhangshan workshop to inscribe the names of the filial, the fraternal, the righteous, and the chaste, collected verified cases, and published a Zhangshan Record—inspiring moral emulation throughout the region.
units.literal: He established a Zhangshan workshop, inscribed the names of filial sons, dutiful younger brothers, righteous husbands, and chaste wives, gathered facts, printed the Zhangshan Record, and for a time custom was stirred.

units.zh: 七年，遷直隸布政使。
units.en: In the seventh year he was transferred to serve as administration commissioner of Zhili.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to be administration commissioner of Zhili.

units.zh: 大旱議賑，總督高斌欲十一月始行，起元力請先普賑一月，俟戶口查竣，再分別加賑。
units.en: During a severe drought the question of famine relief arose; Governor Gao Bin wanted to wait until the eleventh month, but Qiyuan pressed for a month of universal relief first, then differentiated additional aid once registries were complete.
units.literal: During great drought, relief was debated; Governor Gao Bin wished to begin in the eleventh month; Qiyuan strongly urged general relief for one month first, and after household registers were checked, additional targeted relief.

units.zh: 有倡言賑戶不賑口者，起元曰：「一戶數口，止賑一二，是且殺七八人矣！」
units.en: Some proposed relief by household rather than by person; Qiyuan objected: "A single household may hold many mouths—relieving only one or two would condemn seven or eight others to die!"
units.literal: Some advocated relieving households but not individual mouths; Qiyuan said: "One household has several mouths—if only one or two are relieved, you would thereby kill seven or eight people!"

units.zh: 檄各屬似此者罪之。
units.en: He circulated orders that subordinates who did likewise would be prosecuted.
units.literal: He ordered all subordinates that anyone doing likewise would be punished.

units.zh: 戶部尚書海望奏清理直隸旗地，有司違限，旨飭責。
units.en: Revenue Minister Haiwang memorialized to settle banner land titles in Zhili; local officials missed deadlines and were censured by the throne.
units.literal: Minister of Revenue Haiwang memorialized to clear up Zhili banner lands; local officials missed the deadline and received imperial rebuke.

units.zh: 斌將劾數州縣應命，起元不可，曰：「旗地非旦夕可清，州縣方賑災，何暇及此？
units.en: Gao Bin was ready to impeach several prefectural and county officials to satisfy the order; Qiyuan refused, saying: "Banner lands cannot be sorted in a day, and the local governments are consumed with famine relief—when could they attend to this?
units.literal: Bin was about to impeach several prefectures and counties to comply; Qiyuan objected, saying: "Banner lands cannot be cleared in a day; prefectures and counties are busy with famine relief—when would they have leisure for this?

units.zh: 獨劾起元可也！」
units.en: Satisfy the order by impeaching Qiyuan alone!"
units.literal: Impeach Qiyuan alone—that will suffice!"

units.zh: 乃止。
units.en: The plan was dropped.
units.literal: And so [the impeachments] stopped.

units.zh: 九年，內轉光祿寺卿。
units.en: In the ninth year he was transferred within the capital to minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
units.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred within the capital to Court of Imperial Entertainments minister.

units.zh: 十三年，移疾歸。
units.en: In the thirteenth year he retired citing illness.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he retired on grounds of illness.

units.zh: 起元自少敦厲廉恥，晚歲杜門誦先儒書。
units.en: Qiyuan had cultivated a stern sense of honor from youth; in his later years he lived in seclusion, reading the classics of the early Confucians.
units.literal: From youth Qiyuan cultivated integrity; in old age he shut his doors and recited the books of the former Confucians.

units.zh: 臨沒，言：「平生學無真得。
units.en: Facing death he said: "Throughout my life I never achieved genuine understanding in learning.
units.literal: On his deathbed he said: "In life I gained no true learning from study.

units.zh: 年來靜中自檢，仰不愧，俯不怍，或庶幾焉！」
units.en: Yet in recent years, reflecting in solitude, I can look up without guilt and down without shame—perhaps in that I have not entirely failed."
units.literal: In recent years, examining myself in quiet, looking up without shame and down without embarrassment—perhaps I have come near to that!"

units.en: (closing quotation mark in the source.)
units.literal: (closing quotation mark in the source.)

units.zh: 何師儉，字桐叔，浙江山陰人。
units.en: He Shijian, whose courtesy name was Tongshu, came from Shanyin in Zhejiang.
units.literal: He Shijian, courtesy name Tongshu, was a man of Shanyin in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 以納貲，於康熙六十年選授兵部員外郎。
units.en: Having purchased his office, he was appointed vice department director in the Ministry of War in the sixtieth year of Kangxi.
units.literal: By purchase of office, in the sixtieth year of Kangxi he was selected and appointed vice department director in the Ministry of War.

units.zh: 奉職勤懇，常數月不出署。
units.en: He served with tireless diligence, often remaining at his office for months on end.
units.literal: He served his post diligently and often did not leave the yamen for months.

units.zh: 雍正元年，遷廣西右江道僉事，部請留任一年，世宗命以升銜留任，賜人葠、貂皮。
units.en: In Yongzheng 1 he was transferred to surveillance commissioner of the Guangxi Right River Circuit; when the ministry asked to retain him another year, the Yongzheng Emperor ordered him kept on with an elevated title and rewarded him with ginseng and sable fur.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he was transferred to be surveillance commissioner of the Guangxi Right River Circuit; the ministry requested he remain one year; the Yongzheng Emperor ordered him retained with promoted rank and bestowed ginseng and sable fur.

units.zh: 師儉以執法卻重賄，忤要人，因誣以避瘴故留部。
units.en: Shijian had offended powerful figures by enforcing the law and refusing large bribes; they slandered him as having lingered at the capital to escape the southern miasma.
units.literal: Shijian, in enforcing the law, refused heavy bribes and offended powerful men, who therefore slandered him as having stayed at the ministry to avoid miasma.

units.zh: 侍郎李紱昌言曰：「今部曹不名一錢，才者尤勞瘁，苟得郡，爭趨之，況監司耶？」
units.en: Vice Minister Li Fu spoke up plainly: "Ministry clerks today take not a single cash in bribes; the ablest work themselves to exhaustion—given a chance at a prefecture they would all scramble for it, let alone a provincial surveillance post."
units.literal: Vice Minister Li Fu spoke forthrightly, saying: "Nowadays ministry clerks do not take a single cash; the able are especially worn with labor—if they could obtain a prefecture, they would all rush for it—how much more so for a surveillance or circuit post?"

units.zh: 期滿，復請留，加按察司副使銜。
units.en: When his term expired he was again retained, with the added title of vice judicial commissioner.
units.literal: When his term expired, he was again requested to remain, with the added rank of vice judicial commissioner.

units.zh: 司疏奏皆出其手，他司事難治者亦時委之。
units.en: He drafted every memorial and report for his bureau, and difficult cases from other bureaus were often assigned to him as well.
units.literal: All bureau memorials and reports came from his hand; difficult matters in other bureaus were also sometimes entrusted to him.

units.zh: 三年，出為江南驛鹽道副使，上召對，勉以操守，复賜人葠、貂皮，許上疏言事。
units.en: In the third year he was posted as vice commissioner of the Jiangnan courier-and-salt circuit; the emperor received him in audience, urged him to maintain his integrity, again granted ginseng and sable fur, and allowed him to submit memorials on policy.
units.literal: In the third year he went out as vice commissioner of the Jiangnan courier and salt circuit; the emperor summoned him for audience, exhorted him on integrity, again bestowed ginseng and sable fur, and permitted him to memorialize on affairs.

units.zh: 四年，調廣東糧驛道副使。
units.en: In the fourth year he was transferred to vice commissioner of the Guangdong grain-and-courier circuit.
units.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to be vice commissioner of the Guangdong grain and courier circuit.

units.zh: 歲大祲，師儉以存留米五萬石給餉，飭所屬緩徵。
units.en: A severe famine struck that year; Shijian drew on fifty thousand dan of reserve grain to pay stipends and ordered his subordinates to defer tax collection.
units.literal: The year suffered great famine; Shijian used fifty thousand dan of retained grain to pay stipends and ordered subordinates to slow tax collection.

units.zh: 或疑專擅獲咎，師儉曰：「請而後行，民已苦箠楚矣！」
units.en: Some worried he would be punished for overstepping his authority; Shijian replied: "If I must ask permission before acting, the people will already have been flogged into misery!"
units.literal: Some feared he would be blamed for acting on his own authority; Shijian said: "If you request permission before acting, the people will already have suffered the bamboo and whip!"

units.zh: 總督孔毓珣與巡撫楊文乾不相能，以師儉署鹽法道，欲引以為助。
units.en: Governor Kong Yuxun and Governor Yang Wenqian were at loggerheads; Yuxun placed Shijian in charge of the salt administration, hoping to win him as an ally.
units.literal: Governor Kong Yuxun and Governor Yang Wenqian were at odds; [Yuxun] had Shijian act as salt commissioner, wishing to draw him as an ally.

units.zh: 文乾疑為毓珣黨，令買銅，將以賠累困之。
units.en: Wenqian suspected him of siding with Yuxun and ordered him to buy copper, planning to ruin him with indemnity claims.
units.literal: Wenqian suspected him of being Yuxun's partisan and ordered him to purchase copper, intending to entangle him in indemnity losses.

units.zh: 明年，文乾入覲，上示以毓珣彈事，亦及師儉，乃知師儉非阿毓珣者。
units.en: The following year Wenqian came to court; the emperor showed him Yuxun's impeachment memorial, which also named Shijian, and Wenqian realized Shijian had not been currying favor with Yuxun.
units.literal: The next year Wenqian came to court; the emperor showed him Yuxun's impeachment memorial, which also mentioned Shijian, and [Wenqian] then knew Shijian was not partial to Yuxun.

units.zh: 令署按察使，毓珣又疑師儉暱文乾。
units.en: The court ordered Shijian to serve as acting judicial commissioner; Yuxun now suspected him of being close to Wenqian.
units.literal: He was ordered to act as judicial commissioner; Yuxun again suspected Shijian of being close to Wenqian.

units.zh: 及文乾卒，劾師儉違禁開礦，侵蝕銅價。
units.en: After Wenqian's death, Yuxun impeached Shijian for illegally opening mines and embezzling funds from the copper purchases.
units.literal: When Wenqian died, [Yuxun] impeached Shijian for violating the prohibition by opening mines and embezzling copper prices.

units.zh: 逾年，署巡撫傅泰會鞫，事始白。
units.en: After more than a year, acting governor Fu Tai jointly investigated the case and Shijian was finally exonerated.
units.literal: More than a year later, Acting Governor Fu Tai jointly tried the case, and the matter was finally cleared.

units.zh: 上知其無罪，命往陝西佐治軍需。
units.en: Knowing him innocent, the emperor sent him to Shaanxi to help manage military logistics.
units.literal: The emperor knew he was innocent and ordered him to Shaanxi to assist in managing military supplies.

units.zh: 師儉在兵部，諳悉諸邊形勢扼塞、戰守機宜、芻餉緩急。
units.en: During his years at the Ministry of War, Shijian had mastered every frontier's strategic terrain, battle plans, and the timing of fodder and pay.
units.literal: While at the Ministry of War, Shijian was thoroughly versed in the strategic chokepoints, offensive and defensive dispositions, and the urgency of fodder and pay on all frontiers.

units.zh: 至涼州，每集議，指畫如素習，總督查郎阿深重之。
units.en: At Liangzhou he took part in every council and directed operations as though he had done so all his life; Governor-General Cha Lang'a came to rely on him deeply.
units.literal: Upon reaching Liangzhou, at every council he directed affairs as if long practiced; Governor-General Cha Lang'a held him in high regard.

units.zh: 署涼莊道參政。
units.en: He served as acting administration commissioner of the Liangzhuang Circuit.
units.literal: He acted as administration commissioner of the Liangzhuang Circuit.

units.zh: 師過涼州，檄至肅州支餉。
units.en: When the army passed through Liangzhou, an urgent order arrived directing that stipends be paid at Suzhou.
units.literal: When the army passed Liangzhou, an urgent dispatch arrived ordering pay disbursed at Suzhou.

units.zh: 兩路遙遠，師儉即以涼州所蓄給之，師行無乏。
units.en: The two routes lay far apart; Shijian immediately drew on Liangzhou's stores to pay the troops, and the army marched without want.
units.literal: The two routes were far apart; Shijian at once supplied from what Liangzhou had stored, and the army marched without shortage.

units.zh: 一日羽書數過，師儉策必調取生兵，峙餦以待。
units.en: One day several urgent dispatches arrived in succession; Shijian judged that fresh troops would be mobilized and stockpiled rations in readiness.
units.literal: One day urgent dispatches passed several times; Shijian surmised fresh troops would certainly be called up and stockpiled provisions to await them.

units.zh: 已而果然。
units.en: Events proved him right.
units.literal: Before long it proved so.

units.zh: 肅州師將行，飛檄令截取公私騾馬，官民皇皇。
units.en: As the Suzhou army prepared to march, an urgent dispatch ordered the seizure of every private and official pack animal, throwing officials and commoners into panic.
units.literal: When the Suzhou army was about to march, a flying dispatch ordered the seizure of all private and official mules and horses; officials and people were in alarm.

units.zh: 師儉曰：「在道官商皆赴肅者，若官頓於途，貨棄於地，非軍前所宜。
units.en: Shijian objected: "Officials and merchants on the road are all headed for Suzhou—if we detain them en route and leave their goods abandoned along the highway, that will not serve the army.
units.literal: Shijian said: "Officials and merchants on the road are all bound for Suzhou—if officials are detained on the way and goods abandoned on the ground, that is not suitable for the army front.

units.zh: 進剿未有定期，何如聽其至肅，釋所載而後供役？
units.en: The campaign has no fixed schedule—why not let them reach Suzhou, unload their goods, and only then press them into service?
units.literal: The advance to suppress has no fixed date—why not let them reach Suzhou, unload their cargoes, and then provide labor?

units.zh: 軍前得人與貨，亦省芻茭解送之煩，是獲兩利也。
units.en: The army would gain both manpower and supplies while sparing the trouble of hauling fodder and fuel forward—a double advantage.
units.literal: The army front would gain both men and goods, and also save the trouble of transporting fodder and fuel—thus obtaining two benefits.

units.zh: 檄雖嚴，吾自當之。」
units.en: However strict the order, I will answer for it myself."
units.literal: Though the dispatch is strict, I will take responsibility myself."

units.zh: 於是官商皆安，軍事亦無誤。
units.en: Officials and merchants were reassured, and military operations proceeded without disruption.
units.literal: Thereupon officials and merchants were all at ease, and military affairs suffered no delay.

units.zh: 尋調補西安鹽驛道副使。
units.en: He was soon transferred to serve as vice commissioner of the Xi'an salt-and-courier circuit.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to fill the post of vice commissioner of the Xi'an salt and courier circuit.

units.zh: 關中旱，詔以湖廣米十萬石自商州龍駒寨運陝西。
units.en: A drought struck Guanzhong; the court ordered one hundred thousand dan of grain from Huguang conveyed from Longjuzhai in Shangzhou into Shaanxi.
units.literal: Guanzhong suffered drought; an edict ordered one hundred thousand dan of Huguang grain transported from Longjuzhai in Shangzhou to Shaanxi.

units.zh: 師儉董其役，未半，大雨谿漲，騾馬少，不足供轉輸。
units.en: Shijian oversaw the transport, but before half the grain had moved, torrential rains swelled the streams; pack animals were scarce and could not sustain the convoys.
units.literal: Shijian supervised the task; before half was done, heavy rain swelled streams, mules and horses were few, and transport could not be supplied.

units.zh: 商於山中無頓積所，水次隘，運艘不齊。
units.en: The Shangyu mountain route offered no place to store grain in bulk; landing stages were cramped and transport boats could not keep a steady schedule.
units.literal: In the Shangyu mountains there were no depots for storage; landings were narrow and transport boats did not arrive together.

units.zh: 師儉以秋穀將登，請止運，民亦不飢。
units.en: Shijian argued that the autumn harvest was near and petitioned to halt the convoys, since the people would not go hungry.
units.literal: Shijian, because autumn grain would soon be harvested, requested that transport cease; the people would not go hungry.

units.zh: 軍中馬缺，檄取驛馬。
units.en: The army was short of horses; an order went out to seize relay-post mounts.
units.literal: The army lacked horses; a dispatch ordered the seizure of relay post horses.

units.zh: 師儉謂：「置郵傳命，如人身血脈，不能一日廢。」
units.en: Shijian protested: "The postal relay system is like the bloodstream of the empire—it cannot be suspended for even a day."
units.literal: Shijian said: "Establishing postal relay for commands is like the blood vessels of the human body—it cannot be abandoned for a single day."

units.zh: 拒不可，事竟寢。
units.en: He refused, and the order was eventually dropped.
units.literal: He refused and would not agree; the matter was ultimately dropped.

units.zh: 擢按察使，數平疑獄。
units.en: Promoted to judicial commissioner, he repeatedly resolved doubtful criminal cases.
units.literal: He was promoted to judicial commissioner and several times settled doubtful cases.

units.zh: 吏有故入人罪者，必按如法，雖貴勢賢親不徇縱。
units.en: When officials had framed innocent defendants, he always prosecuted them to the full extent of the law, showing no favor even to the powerful or well connected.
units.literal: When officials had intentionally entered false charges against others, he always prosecuted according to law, not yielding even to the powerful, eminent, or kin.

units.zh: 十三年，以目疾乞休。
units.en: In the thirteenth year he retired citing eye trouble.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he requested retirement on grounds of eye disease.

units.zh: 高宗即位，赦詔至，時目已失明，令吏誦案牘，諦聽，得邀赦典者，立出之而後上陳。
units.en: When the Qianlong Emperor took the throne, an amnesty arrived; though Shijian was by then completely blind, he had clerks read case files aloud and listened carefully—any prisoner eligible for amnesty he released immediately before reporting upward.
units.literal: When the Gaozong Emperor acceded, an amnesty edict arrived; by then his eyes were already blind; he had clerks read case documents and listened intently; those who could claim amnesty he released at once and then reported upward.

units.zh: 留兩月，畢其事始歸。
units.en: He stayed two months until every case was settled, then returned home.
units.literal: He remained two months, finished the business, and only then returned home.

units.zh: 後卒於家，陝西祀名宦。
units.en: He later died at home and was entered in Shaanxi's shrine of eminent officials.
units.literal: Later he died at home; Shaanxi enshrined him among notable officials.

units.zh: 唐繼祖，字序皇，江南江都人。
units.en: Tang Jizu, whose courtesy name was Xuhuang, came from Jiangdu in Jiangnan.
units.literal: Tang Jizu, courtesy name Xuhuang, was a man of Jiangdu in Jiangnan.

units.zh: 康熙六十年進士，選庶吉士。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in the sixtieth year of Kangxi and entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor.
units.literal: In the sixtieth year of Kangxi he became a jinshi and was chosen as a Hanlin bachelor.

units.zh: 雍正元年，散館，授編修，轉禮部員外郎。
units.en: In Yongzheng 1, after completing his Hanlin term, he was appointed compiler and then transferred to vice department director in the Ministry of Rites.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, upon leaving the Hanlin Academy, he was appointed compiler and transferred to be vice department director in the Ministry of Rites.

units.zh: 五年，考選浙江道御史。
units.en: In the fifth year he was selected by examination as censor of the Zhejiang circuit.
units.literal: In the fifth year he was selected by examination as censor of the Zhejiang Circuit.

units.zh: 七年，授工科給事中。
units.en: In the seventh year he was appointed supervising secretary in the Ministry of Works.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed supervising secretary of the Ministry of Works.

units.zh: 命察八旗虧帑，律侵挪皆不赦，犯者貧，羈獄二三十年不結。
units.en: He was ordered to investigate deficits in the Eight Banners treasuries; regulations on embezzlement allowed no amnesty, and poor offenders languished in prison twenty or thirty years without resolution.
units.literal: He was ordered to investigate deficits in the Eight Banners treasuries; regulations on embezzlement provided no pardon; offenders were poor and were held in prison twenty or thirty years without conclusion.

units.zh: 繼祖為核減開除，奏請豁免，積牘一清。
units.en: Jizu took charge of the audit-and-dismissal cases, memorialized for exemptions, and cleared the entire backlog.
units.literal: Jizu handled audit-reduction and dismissals, memorialized requesting exemption, and the accumulated files were all cleared.

units.zh: 命巡西城，回民聚居，頑獷不法，嚴治之，有犯必懲，悉斂戢。
units.en: Ordered to patrol the western city, where Hui communities had grown stubborn and lawless, he cracked down hard—every offense brought punishment—and all were brought to heel.
units.literal: He was ordered to inspect the western city; Hui people lived gathered together, stubborn, fierce, and lawless; he governed them strictly, punishing every offense, and all were subdued.

units.zh: 建倉東便門外，多發塚墓，毀祠宇，繼祖陳其不便，改地營建，塚墓祠宇並修復。
units.en: Plans to build a granary outside Dongbian Gate had opened many graves and demolished shrines. Jizu memorialized against it; the site was moved, and the tombs and shrines were restored.
units.literal: A granary was being built outside the Dongbian Gate; many tombs were excavated and shrines destroyed; Jizu memorialized on the inconvenience, changed the site for construction, and tombs and shrines were all restored.

units.zh: 南漕愆期，命赴淮安巡視。
units.en: When southern tribute grain fell behind schedule, he was sent to Huai'an to oversee transport.
units.literal: Southern grain transport missed its deadline; he was ordered to go to Huai'an to inspect.

units.zh: 繼祖馳至，不更張成法，惟選幹吏催督，懲其疲惰。
units.en: Jizu hurried there, changed none of the established procedures, but put capable officers in charge of supervision and punished slackness.
units.literal: Jizu rushed there, did not change established methods, only selected capable clerks to press and supervise, and punished slackness and laziness.

units.zh: 兩閱月，糧艘悉抵通州。
units.en: Within two months every grain barge had reached Tongzhou.
units.literal: In two months, grain barges all reached Tongzhou.

units.zh: 條上漕務利病，下部議行。
units.en: He submitted a detailed memorial on the strengths and abuses of grain transport; the ministries deliberated and put his recommendations into effect.
units.literal: He memorialized item by item on advantages and abuses of grain transport affairs; it was referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.

units.zh: 七年，命往湖南讞獄，並巡察湖南、湖北兩省，裹糧出，有餽觴酒豆肉，皆卻之，令行禁止。
units.en: In the seventh year he was ordered to Hunan to review criminal cases and to inspect both Hunan and Hubei. He traveled at his own expense; gifts of wine, beans, or meat were all refused, and he forbade such offerings outright.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered to go to Hunan to adjudicate criminal cases, and also to inspect Hunan and Hubei provinces; he set out carrying his own rations; when gifts of wine, beans, and meat were offered, he refused them all and ordered a ban enforced.

units.zh: 與巡撫趙申喬同按永順苗變獄，群情帖服，苗疆以安。
units.en: Together with Grand Coordinator Zhao Shenqiao he investigated the Yongshun Miao uprising; the public submitted, and the Miao frontier was pacified.
units.literal: Together with Grand Coordinator Zhao Shenqiao he jointly investigated the Yongshun Miao rebellion case; popular sentiment submitted in compliance, and the Miao frontier was thereby pacified.

units.zh: 湖南捕役多通盜，奏請捕役為盜，加重治罪，報可，入新例。
units.en: Many Hunan constables colluded with bandits. He memorialized that constables who turned bandit should face heavier penalties; the request was approved and entered the new code.
units.literal: In Hunan many arrest officers colluded with bandits; he memorialized requesting that arrest officers who acted as bandits receive heavier punishment; approval was granted, and it entered the new statutes.

units.zh: 八年，擢通政司參議。
units.en: In the eighth year he was promoted to counselor in the Office of Transmission.
units.literal: In the eighth year he was promoted to counselor of the Office of Transmission.

units.zh: 九年，擢鴻臚寺卿。
units.en: In the ninth year he was promoted to director of the Court of State Ceremonial.
units.literal: In the ninth year he was promoted to director of the Court of State Ceremonial.

units.zh: 尋命以本銜署河南按察使，旋授湖北按察使。
units.en: He was soon ordered to serve as acting judicial commissioner of Henan at his present rank, then appointed judicial commissioner of Hubei.
units.literal: Soon he was ordered, retaining his current rank, to act as Henan judicial commissioner; shortly after he was appointed Hubei judicial commissioner.

units.zh: 繼祖在兩湖久，熟知吏民情偽。
units.en: Having served long in the two Hu provinces, Jizu knew officials and commoners alike—their truths and their lies.
units.literal: Jizu had long been in the two Hu provinces and thoroughly knew the truth and falsehood of officials' and people's situations.

units.zh: 楚俗刁健，黠吏與姦豪通，伺官喜怒，訟益難治。
units.en: Hubei folk were sharp and litigious; cunning clerks colluded with local bullies, watched every shift in an official's mood, and lawsuits grew harder to settle.
units.literal: Chu custom was crafty and contentious; cunning clerks colluded with powerful scoundrels, watched officials' joys and anger, and lawsuits became ever harder to govern.

units.zh: 繼祖閉諸胥於一室，不令與外通，訟風衰減。
units.en: Jizu confined the yamen clerks to a single room, cut off from outsiders, and the litigious mania subsided.
units.literal: Jizu shut all the minor clerks in one room, not allowing them to communicate with the outside, and the wind of litigation declined.

units.zh: 雪監利女子冤獄，按鍾祥民變，皆為時所稱。
units.en: He righted a wrongful conviction in Jianli involving a woman, investigated the popular disturbance at Zhongxiang, and both won contemporary praise.
units.literal: He cleared the wrongful case of a woman in Jianli, investigated the popular uprising in Zhongxiang, and both were praised by contemporaries.

units.zh: 世宗馭吏嚴，內外大僚凜凜，救過不暇。
units.en: The Yongzheng Emperor ruled his officials with an iron hand; high officers at court and in the provinces lived in awe, scrambling merely to cover their mistakes.
units.literal: Emperor Shizong governed officials strictly; senior officials within and without were in awe, with no leisure to remedy their faults.

units.zh: 繼祖一意展舒，所陳奏無不允。
units.en: Jizu alone acted with confidence and ease; every proposal he submitted won approval.
units.literal: Jizu in all matters acted freely and at ease; every memorial he submitted was granted.

units.zh: 上欲大用之，出巡察，賜以摺匣，許奏事，曰：「朕於督撫賢者始賜摺匣，汝宜好為之！」
units.en: The emperor intended to promote him further. Before he left on his inspection tour, he was granted a memorial case and permission to report directly to the throne. The emperor said, "I grant the memorial case only to governors and governors-general I deem worthy. Conduct yourself accordingly!"
units.literal: The Emperor wished to employ him on a grand scale; as he went out on inspection tour, he was granted a memorial case and permitted to memorialize; he said: "I grant the memorial case only to worthy governors-general and governors—you should do well!"

units.zh: 調江西，未之任，以疾乞歸。
units.en: He was transferred to Jiangxi but never took up the post, pleading illness to return home.
units.literal: He was transferred to Jiangxi, did not take up the post, and requested leave to return home on account of illness.

units.zh: 病癒將出，遽卒。
units.en: His illness had healed and he was preparing to depart when he died suddenly.
units.literal: When his illness was cured and he was about to set out, he suddenly died.

units.zh: 馬維翰，字墨麟，浙江海鹽人。
units.en: Ma Weihan, whose courtesy name was Molin, came from Haiyan in Zhejiang.
units.literal: Ma Weihan, courtesy name Molin, was a man of Haiyan in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 康熙六十年進士。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in the sixtieth year of Kangxi.
units.literal: In the sixtieth year of Kangxi he became a jinshi.

units.zh: 雍正元年，授吏部主事。
units.en: In Yongzheng 1 he was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 甫視事，杖姦胥，銓政清肅。
units.en: As soon as he took office, he flogged corrupt clerks, and appointment affairs were brought under strict order.
units.literal: As soon as he took office he flogged corrupt clerks, and appointment affairs were cleared and disciplined.

units.zh: 轉員外郎，考選陝西道御史，遷工科給事中，監督倉場，所至有聲。
units.en: Promoted to vice director, he was selected as censor of the Shaanxi circuit, then appointed supervising secretary of the Ministry of Works and supervisor of the granary depot. Wherever he served, he earned renown.
units.literal: He transferred to vice director, was selected by examination as censor on the Shaanxi circuit, moved to supervising secretary of the Ministry of Works, and supervised the granary depot—wherever he went he gained renown.

units.zh: 六年，命赴四川清丈田畝，時同奉使者四。
units.en: In the sixth year, he was sent to Sichuan to survey field land along with three other commissioners.
units.literal: In the sixth year he was ordered to Sichuan to survey field land; at the time four commissioners were sent on the same mission.

units.zh: 維翰分赴建昌道屬，具有條理，糧浮於田者必請減，逾年事竣。
units.en: Weihan was assigned to the Jianchang Circuit. His work was methodical, and wherever grain quotas exceeded actual land he requested reductions. Within a year the survey was complete.
units.literal: Weihan was assigned to the Jianchang Circuit jurisdiction; his work was well ordered, and wherever grain quota exceeded land he always requested reduction; within a year the task was completed.

units.zh: 御史吳濤在川東丈田不實，以維翰助之。
units.en: Censor Wu Tao had surveyed land falsely in eastern Sichuan, and Weihan was sent to assist him.
units.literal: Censor Wu Tao in eastern Sichuan surveyed land falsely; Weihan was sent to assist him.

units.zh: 至則發其弊，遂以維翰代任。
units.en: When Weihan arrived, he exposed the abuses and was appointed to replace Wu Tao.
units.literal: When he arrived he exposed the abuses, and Weihan was then appointed to replace him.

units.zh: 巡撫憲德薦可大用。
units.en: Governor Xiande recommended him as fit for high office.
units.literal: Governor Xiande recommended him as fit for great employment.

units.zh: 八年，留補建昌道副使，疏陳二事：四川俗好訟，州縣斷獄苟簡，案牘不具，奸民輒翻控，淆亂是非，請設幕職以襄治理；
units.en: In the eighth year he was retained as vice commissioner of the Jianchang Circuit and memorialized on two matters: Sichuan was litigious, and prefectures and counties judged cases perfunctorily with incomplete records, allowing scoundrels to overturn verdicts and confuse right and wrong. He proposed establishing staff posts to assist governance;
units.literal: In the eighth year he remained to fill the post of vice commissioner of the Jianchang Circuit and memorialized on two matters: Sichuan custom favored litigation; prefectures and counties judged cases perfunctorily, records were incomplete, and scoundrels repeatedly appealed and overturned verdicts, confusing right and wrong—he requested staff posts to assist governance;

units.zh: 又民鮮土著，多結草屋，輕於遷徙，焚劫輒致災，請發官款造磚甓，勸民多建瓦屋。
units.en: He also noted that few people were native settlers; most lived in thatched huts and moved easily, so arson and robbery often caused disaster. He proposed using official funds to make bricks and tiles and encourage tile-roofed construction.
units.literal: Also, the people were rarely native settlers, mostly building thatched huts and moving lightly; arson and robbery often caused disaster—he requested official funds to make bricks and tiles and encourage the people to build more tile-roofed houses.

units.zh: 上斥其非政要，以其疏示憲德，謂：「汝薦可大用者乃若此！」
units.en: The emperor dismissed these as peripheral to governance, showed the memorial to Xiande, and said, "This is the man you recommended for high office!"
units.literal: The emperor rebuked these as not essential to governance, showed the memorial to Xiande, and said: "The man you recommended for great employment is like this!"

units.zh: 然維翰勇於任事，相度要害，改黎州千戶所設清溪縣。
units.en: Yet Weihan was bold in action. Surveying strategic points, he converted the Lizhou Guard thousand-household post into Qingxi County.
units.literal: Yet Weihan was bold in undertaking affairs; surveying key points, he changed the Lizhou Guard thousand-household post and established Qingxi County.

units.zh: 烏蒙苗亂，出師會剿，維翰治軍需，供糗糧芻茭，鑿雪通道，與廝卒同甘苦。
units.en: When the Wumeng Miao rebelled and troops were dispatched for joint suppression, Weihan managed military supplies, providing rations and fodder, cutting paths through snow, and sharing hardships with common soldiers.
units.literal: When the Wumeng Miao rebelled and troops were dispatched for joint suppression, Weihan managed military supplies, providing rations and fodder, cutting paths through snow, and sharing hardships with common soldiers.

units.zh: 論剿撫悉中機宜，事乃定。
units.en: His proposals on suppression and pacification all hit the mark, and the rebellion was settled.
units.literal: His proposals on suppression and pacification all hit the mark, and the affair was settled.

units.zh: 涼山地震數百里，勘災散賑，民感之。
units.en: When an earthquake struck Liangshan over several hundred li, he surveyed the damage and distributed relief, winning the people's gratitude.
units.literal: An earthquake struck Liangshan for several hundred li; he surveyed disaster and distributed relief, and the people were grateful.

units.zh: 礦廠擾蠻，起為亂，方進剿。
units.en: Mining operations disturbed the tribes, who rose in rebellion as troops were advancing to suppress them.
units.literal: Mining operations disturbed the tribes, who rose in rebellion; suppression was just advancing.

units.zh: 維翰力陳營兵不戢及各廠病蠻狀，請罷廠撤兵，撫各番，止誅其魁。
units.en: Weihan strongly memorialized on undisciplined camp soldiers and the suffering of tribes at each mine, requesting that mines be abolished, troops withdrawn, each tribe pacified, and only the ringleaders executed.
units.literal: Weihan strongly memorialized on undisciplined camp soldiers and the suffering of tribes at each mine, requesting abolition of mines and withdrawal of troops, pacifying each tribe, and executing only the ringleaders.

units.zh: 在川七年，不阿上官。
units.en: In seven years in Sichuan, he never fawned on superiors.
units.literal: In seven years in Sichuan he never fawned on superiors.

units.zh: 旋被構，維翰揭部請解職赴質。
units.en: Soon he was framed. Weihan memorialized the ministry requesting dismissal so he could face trial.
units.literal: Soon he was framed; Weihan memorialized the ministry requesting dismissal to face trial.

units.zh: 時親王總部事，特威重，捽使免冠。
units.en: At the time a prince presided over the ministry with special authority and had him seized and forced to remove his official cap.
units.literal: At the time a prince presided over the ministry with special authority and dignity, and had him seized and forced to remove his cap.

units.zh: 維翰以手按冠抗聲曰：「奉旨不免冠！」
units.en: Weihan pressed his cap with his hand and cried out, "By imperial decree I need not remove my cap!"
units.literal: Weihan pressed his cap with his hand and cried out: "By imperial decree I need not remove my cap!"

units.zh: 譙問故，則又抗聲曰：「旨解職，非革職也！」
units.en: When rebuked and asked why, he cried out again, "The decree was dismissal from office, not dismissal from rank!"
units.literal: When rebuked and asked why, he again cried out: "The decree was dismissal from office, not dismissal from rank!"

units.zh: 部乃疏請奪官。
units.en: The ministry then memorialized requesting that his office be stripped.
units.literal: The ministry then memorialized requesting stripping of office.

units.zh: 事旋白。
units.en: The matter was soon cleared.
units.literal: The matter was soon cleared.

units.zh: 乾隆二年，起授江南常鎮道參議。
units.en: In the second year of Qianlong, he was recalled and appointed administration commissioner of the Chang-Zhen Circuit in Jiangnan.
units.literal: In the second year of Qianlong he was recalled and appointed administration commissioner of the Chang-Zhen Circuit in Jiangnan.

units.zh: 丁父憂，歸，卒於家。
units.en: When his father died, he returned home and died there.
units.literal: When his father died he returned home and died there.

units.zh: 餘甸，字田生，福建福清人。
units.en: Yu Dian, styled Tiansheng, came from Fuqing in Fujian.
units.literal: Yu Dian, courtesy name Tiansheng, was a native of Fuqing in Fujian.

units.zh: 康熙四十五年進士。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in the forty-fifth year of Kangxi.
units.literal: In the forty-fifth year of Kangxi he passed the jinshi examination.

units.zh: 居鄉勵名節，巡撫張伯行重之，延主鼇峰書院。
units.en: At home he cultivated reputation and integrity. Governor Zhang Boxing valued him and invited him to head the Aofeng Academy.
units.literal: Living in his home district he cultivated reputation and integrity; Governor Zhang Boxing valued him and invited him to head the Aofeng Academy.

units.zh: 授四川江津知縣，民投牒者，片言立決遣，訟為之簡。
units.en: Appointed magistrate of Jiangjin in Sichuan, he decided petitions in a few words and litigation dwindled.
units.literal: Appointed magistrate of Jiangjin in Sichuan, when the people submitted petitions he decided and dispatched in a few words, and litigation was thereby simplified.

units.zh: 日與諸生誦說文藝，疏解性理。
units.en: Daily he lectured scholars on literature and explained Neo-Confucian principle.
units.literal: Daily he lectured scholars on literature and explained Neo-Confucian principle.

units.zh: 所徵賦即儲庫，不入私室。
units.en: Taxes collected went directly to the treasury, never entering his private quarters.
units.literal: Taxes collected were stored directly in the treasury, never entering his private quarters.

units.zh: 時青海用兵，巡撫年羹堯督餉，多額外急徵，檄再三至，甸不應。
units.en: While Qinghai was at war, Governor Nian Gengyao supervised provisions and repeatedly imposed extra urgent levies. Dispatches arrived again and again, but Dian did not comply.
units.literal: At the time Qinghai was at war; Governor Nian Gengyao supervised provisions and repeatedly imposed extra urgent levies; dispatches came again and again, and Dian did not respond.

units.zh: 乃使僕持檄告諭，自朝至晡，甸不出，使者譁。
units.en: Gengyao sent a servant with a dispatch to announce the order. From morning until dusk Dian did not emerge, and the messenger raised an uproar.
units.literal: Gengyao then sent a servant with a dispatch to announce and instruct; from morning until dusk Dian did not come out, and the messenger made an uproar.

units.zh: 甸坐堂皇，命反接，將杖之，丞簿力為請，久之乃釋其縛。
units.en: Dian sat in the hall, ordered the messenger bound and was about to flog him. The assistant magistrate and registrar pleaded forcefully, and only after a long delay were his bonds released.
units.literal: Dian sat in the hall, ordered him bound hand and foot behind his back and was about to flog him; the assistant magistrate and registrar pleaded forcefully, and after long delay his bonds were released.

units.zh: 越日，使者索檄，甸曰：「汝還報，我閉門待劾，檄已達京師矣。」
units.en: The next day the messenger demanded the dispatch. Dian said, "Go back and report that I have closed my doors awaiting impeachment—the dispatch has already reached the capital."
units.literal: The next day the messenger demanded the dispatch; Dian said: "Go back and report—I have closed my doors awaiting impeachment; the dispatch has already reached the capital."

units.zh: 羹堯亦置之。
units.en: Gengyao also let the matter drop.
units.literal: Gengyao also let the matter drop.

units.zh: 行取吏部主事，時尚書張鵬翮、侍郎湯右曾皆以幹濟名，甸遇當爭辯者，侃侃無所撓。
units.en: Selected for the Ministry of Personnel, he served under Minister Zhang Penghe and Vice Minister Tang Youzeng, both famed for capability. When matters required argument, Dian spoke forthrightly without yielding.
units.literal: Selected for office as principal secretary in the Ministry of Personnel; at the time Minister Zhang Penghe and Vice Minister Tang Youzeng were both famed for capability; when Dian encountered matters requiring argument he spoke forthrightly without yielding.

units.zh: 主選三年，權要富人請託多格不行。
units.en: In charge of appointments for three years, he blocked most requests from the powerful and wealthy.
units.literal: In charge of appointments for three years, requests from the powerful and wealthy were mostly blocked and not granted.

units.zh: 將告歸，條文書已駁議未奏者十餘事，曰：「此皆作姦巧法易為所蒙，必上聞，吾乃去。」
units.en: Before requesting retirement, he itemized more than ten documents already rejected in deliberation but not yet submitted, saying, "These are all crafty devices by which one could easily be deceived—they must be reported to the throne before I leave."
units.literal: About to request retirement, he itemized more than ten documents already rejected in deliberation but not yet submitted, saying: "These are all crafty devices easy to deceive by— they must be reported upward; only then will I leave."

units.zh: 父憂免喪，猶廬墓。
units.en: After mourning for his father, he still lived in a hut by his father's tomb.
units.literal: After mourning for his father and leaving mourning, he still lived by his father's tomb.

units.zh: 以河道總督陳鵬年疏薦，擢山東兗寧道。
units.en: On the recommendation of Grand Canal Governor Chen Pengnian, he was promoted to the Yan-Ning Circuit in Shandong.
units.literal: On the recommendation of Grand Canal Governor Chen Pengnian he was promoted to the Yan-Ning Circuit.

units.zh: 釐工剔弊，一袪積習，甚得士民心。
units.en: He rectified engineering and eliminated abuses, sweeping away entrenched custom, and won the hearts of gentry and commoners.
units.literal: He rectified engineering and eliminated abuses, sweeping away accumulated custom, and greatly won the hearts of gentry and people.

units.zh: 鵬年卒，齊蘇勒為河督，以工事劾甸，行河至濟寧，士民群聚乞還甸。
units.en: When Pengnian died, Qisule became canal governor and impeached Dian over engineering. When Qisule traveled the canal to Jining, gentry and commoners gathered in crowds begging for Dian's return.
units.literal: When Pengnian died, Qisule became canal governor and impeached Dian on engineering matters; when he traveled the canal to Jining, gentry and people gathered in crowds begging for Dian's return.

units.zh: 齊蘇勒疏陳，召入見。
units.en: Qisule memorialized on this, and Dian was summoned for audience.
units.literal: Qisule memorialized on this and Dian was summoned for audience.

units.zh: 雍正二年四月，授山東按察使。
units.en: In the fourth month of the second year of Yongzheng, he was appointed Shandong provincial judicial commissioner.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Yongzheng he was appointed Shandong provincial judicial commissioner.

units.zh: 攜二僕，買驢之官，務崇禮教，輕刑罰，政化大行。
units.en: He took two servants, bought a donkey, and rode to office. Emphasizing ritual teaching and lighter punishments, he brought about widespread moral reform.
units.literal: He took two servants, bought a donkey, and went to office; he emphasized ritual teaching and lightened punishments, and political transformation was widely carried out.

units.zh: 十一月，召詣京師。
units.en: In the eleventh month, he was summoned to the capital.
units.literal: In the eleventh month he was summoned to the capital.

units.zh: 三年，擢順天府丞。
units.en: In the third year, he was promoted to vice director of Shuntian Prefecture.
units.literal: In the third year he was promoted to vice director of Shuntian Prefecture.

units.zh: 甸歷官盡革陋規，為按察使，愍囚不能自衣食，取鹽商歲饋三之一以資給之。
units.en: Throughout his career Dian abolished all irregular fees. As provincial judicial commissioner, pitying prisoners who could not feed or clothe themselves, he took one-third of the salt merchants' annual gifts to support them.
units.literal: Throughout his offices Dian abolished all irregular fees; as provincial judicial commissioner, pitying prisoners unable to feed and clothe themselves, he took one-third of the salt merchants' annual gifts to support them.

units.zh: 兼完囹圄，修學宮、書院，委有司出入註籍。
units.en: He also repaired prisons, academies, and colleges, requiring local officials to keep registers of all income and expenditure.
units.literal: He also repaired prisons, academies, and colleges, entrusting local officials to keep registers of income and expenditure.

units.zh: 既去官，上命內閣學士繆沅清察山東鹽政諸弊，舉是劾甸，奪官，歸。
units.en: After leaving office, the emperor ordered Grand Secretariat Academician Miao Yuan to investigate abuses in Shandong salt administration. Citing Dian's use of merchant gifts, Yuan impeached him, stripped his office, and Dian returned home.
units.literal: After leaving office, the emperor ordered Grand Secretariat Academician Miao Yuan to investigate abuses in Shandong salt administration; citing this, he impeached Dian, stripped his office, and Dian returned home.

units.zh: 甸用唐人詩語為人書楹帖，其人有怨家，訐於有司，以為怨望。
units.en: Dian had written couplets for others using lines from Tang poetry. One recipient had an enemy who denounced the couplets to officials as expressions of resentment against the throne.
units.literal: Dian used Tang-dynasty poetry lines to write couplets for others; one such person had an enemy who denounced him to officials as harboring resentment.

units.zh: 有司以甸所書也，並下甸於獄。
units.en: Because Dian had written the couplets, the officials imprisoned him as well.
units.literal: The officials, because Dian had written them, also imprisoned Dian.

units.zh: 事白，遽卒。
units.en: When the matter was cleared, he suddenly died.
units.literal: When the matter was cleared, he suddenly died.

units.zh: 王葉滋，字槐青，江南華亭人。
units.en: Wang Yezi, styled Huaiqing, came from Huating in Jiangnan.
units.literal: Wang Yezi, courtesy name Huaiqing, was a native of Huating in Jiangnan.

units.zh: 弱冠，補諸生。
units.en: In his youth he became a licentiate.
units.literal: In his youth he became a licentiate.

units.zh: 浙江巡撫硃軾闢佐幕，器其才。
units.en: Zhejiang Governor Zhu Shi recruited him to his staff and valued his talent.
units.literal: Zhejiang Governor Zhu Shi opened a staff and valued his talent.

units.zh: 雍正元年，重開明史館，軾薦之，引見稱旨，命入館纂修。
units.en: In the first year of Yongzheng, when the Ming History Office reopened, Zhu Shi recommended him. He pleased the emperor at audience and was ordered to join the compilation staff.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng the Ming History Office was reopened; Shi recommended him; on audience he pleased the emperor and was ordered to enter the office to compile and edit.

units.zh: 舉順天鄉試。
units.en: He passed the Shuntian provincial examination.
units.literal: He passed the Shuntian provincial examination.

units.zh: 福敏督湖廣，世宗命葉滋往贊其幕。
units.en: When Fu Min governed Huguang, the Shizong Emperor ordered Yezi to assist his staff.
units.literal: Fu Min governed Huguang; the Shizong Emperor ordered Yezi to assist his staff.

units.zh: 五年，應禮部試，甫畢，上召見，問湖廣吏治、民生利弊，奏對甚悉，趣馳傳還湖廣。
units.en: In the fifth year he took the Ministry of Rites examination. As soon as it ended the emperor summoned him and asked about Huguang governance and the welfare of the people. His replies were thorough, and he was ordered to hurry back to Huguang by relay.
units.literal: In the fifth year he took the Ministry of Rites examination; as soon as it ended the emperor summoned him and asked about Huguang official governance and the benefits and harms to people's livelihood; his replies were thorough, and he was urged to hurry back by relay to Huguang.

units.zh: 榜發中式，未與殿試，賜二甲進士，即授常德知府。
units.en: When the results were posted he had passed. Before the palace examination he was granted second-rank jinshi status and immediately appointed prefect of Changde.
units.literal: When the results were posted he had passed; before taking the palace examination he was granted second-rank jinshi and immediately appointed prefect of Changde.

units.zh: 常德例，知府至，行戶更新照，規費四千金，葉滋革其例。
units.en: By Changde custom, when a new prefect arrived, brokerage houses paid four thousand taels to renew licenses. Yezi abolished this custom.
units.literal: By Changde custom, when the prefect arrived, brokerage houses renewed licenses at a fee of four thousand taels; Yezi abolished this custom.

units.zh: 境數被水災，請帑增築花貓新陂堤堰，豁被水荒田額糧，民德之。
units.en: The district suffered repeated floods. He requested treasury funds to enlarge the Huamao and Xinpo dikes and exempted grain quotas on flooded wasteland. The people were grateful.
units.literal: The district suffered repeated flood disasters; he requested treasury funds to enlarge the Huamao and Xinpo dikes and exempted grain quota on flooded wasteland; the people were grateful.

units.zh: 辰州關木稅為利藪，時議移關常德，葉滋恐累民，拒之，請仍舊制。
units.en: The Chenzhou Pass timber tax was a lucrative source of revenue. Some proposed moving the pass to Changde, but Yezi feared burdening the people, refused, and requested that the old system remain.
units.literal: The Chenzhou Pass timber tax was a rich profit source; at the time there was discussion of moving the pass to Changde; Yezi feared burdening the people, refused, and requested the old system remain.

units.zh: 行法不避豪貴，興學造士，薦舉優行諸生陳悌為武平知縣，貴金馬為上蔡知縣，劉樵為清平知縣，並為良吏。
units.en: Enforcing the law without fear of the powerful, promoting learning and cultivating scholars, he recommended the excellent licentiate Chen Ti as magistrate of Wuping, Gui Jinma as magistrate of Shangcai, and Liu Qiao as magistrate of Qingping—all became capable officials.
units.literal: Enforcing law without avoiding the powerful and noble, promoting learning and cultivating scholars, he recommended the excellent licentiate Chen Ti as magistrate of Wuping, Gui Jinma as magistrate of Shangcai, and Liu Qiao as magistrate of Qingping—all became good officials.

units.zh: 署岳州、辰州二府，攝岳常道副使。
units.en: He served as acting prefect of Yuezhou and Chenzhou and as acting vice commissioner of the Yue-Chang Circuit.
units.literal: He acted as prefect of Yuezhou and Chenzhou, and also as vice commissioner of the Yue-Chang Circuit.

units.zh: 久之，授辰沅靖道副使。
units.en: After long service, he was appointed vice commissioner of the Chen-Yuan-Jing Circuit.
units.literal: After long service he was appointed vice commissioner of the Chen-Yuan-Jing Circuit.

units.zh: 時苗疆初闢，清林箐，增汛堠，規模肅然。
units.en: The Miao frontier had only recently been opened. He cleared forest ravines, increased guard posts, and established an imposing arrangement.
units.literal: At the time the Miao frontier was newly opened; he cleared forest ravines, increased guard posts, and the arrangement was imposing.

units.zh: 所屬綏寧、城步與黔疆犬牙錯。
units.en: Suining and Chengbu under his jurisdiction interlocked with the Guizhou frontier like a chessboard.
units.literal: Suining and Chengbu under his jurisdiction interlocked with the Guizhou frontier like dog's teeth.

units.zh: 嘗率數騎，持酒肉鹽菸，循行苗砦。
units.en: He once led a few horsemen, carrying wine, meat, salt, and tobacco, touring Miao stockades in turn.
units.literal: He once led a few horsemen, carrying wine, meat, salt, and tobacco, and toured Miao stockades in turn.

units.zh: 群苗迎拜，謂「上官親我」。
units.en: The Miao came out to welcome him, saying, "The superior cares for us personally."
units.literal: The Miao masses came out to welcome and bow, saying "The superior cares for us personally."

units.zh: 召諸頭人集校場，賜花紅銀牌，宣上德意，勸以禮義。
units.en: He summoned all headmen to the drill ground, bestowed flowered red-silver plaques, proclaimed the emperor's benevolent intent, and exhorted them in ritual and righteousness.
units.literal: He summoned all headmen to assemble at the drill ground, bestowed flowered red-silver plaques, proclaimed the emperor's benevolent intent, and exhorted them with ritual and righteousness.

units.zh: 因偕總兵閱兵耀軍容，群苗帖服。
units.en: Then together with the regional commander he reviewed troops to display military might, and the Miao submitted.
units.literal: Then together with the regional commander he reviewed troops to display military might, and the Miao masses submitted.

units.zh: 署按察使，調糧儲道，舊有漕費，悉歸公用。
units.en: He served as acting provincial judicial commissioner and was transferred to grain storage commissioner. Former tribute transport fees all went to public use.
units.literal: He acted as provincial judicial commissioner and was transferred to grain storage commissioner; former tribute transport fees all went to public use.

units.zh: 值貴州苗亂，師進剿，葉滋駐辰州治軍需，剋期辦。
units.en: When the Guizhou Miao rebelled and troops marched to suppress them, Yezi remained at Chenzhou managing military supplies and met every deadline.
units.literal: When the Guizhou Miao rebelled and troops advanced for suppression, Yezi remained at Chenzhou managing military supplies and completed them on schedule.

units.zh: 綏寧苗蠢動，為貴州苗應。
units.en: The Suining Miao stirred restlessly in response to the Guizhou rebellion.
units.literal: The Suining Miao stirred restlessly in response to the Guizhou Miao.

units.zh: 葉滋條上剿撫事，悉中窾要。
units.en: Yezi submitted a detailed plan for suppression and pacification, every point striking at the heart of the matter.
units.literal: Yezi itemized and submitted matters of suppression and pacification, all hitting the vital points.

units.zh: 大吏令駐綏寧指揮，積勞疾作，卒於山中。
units.en: Senior officials ordered him to remain at Suining to direct operations. Exhaustion brought on illness, and he died in the mountains.
units.literal: High officials ordered him to remain at Suining to direct affairs; accumulated exhaustion brought on illness, and he died in the mountains.

units.zh: 葉滋初以文學受知，及官於外，所至有聲績。
units.en: Yezi first won recognition for his literary learning, and once he held office in the provinces, he earned renown wherever he served.
units.literal: Yezi was first recognized for literary learning; once he held office outside the capital, wherever he went he gained renown and achievement.

units.zh: 卒時年僅五十五，世咸惜之。
units.en: He was only fifty-five when he died, and all who knew of him mourned the loss.
units.literal: When he died he was only fifty-five; the world all regretted it.

units.zh: 劉而位，字爾爵，山西汾陽人。
units.en: Liu Erwei, styled Erjue, came from Fenyang in Shanxi.
units.literal: Liu Erwei, courtesy name Erjue, was a native of Fenyang in Shanxi.

units.zh: 康熙五十二年舉人，授河南安陽知縣。
units.en: He passed the provincial examination in the fifty-second year of Kangxi and was appointed magistrate of Anyang in Henan.
units.literal: In the fifty-second year of Kangxi he passed the provincial examination and was appointed magistrate of Anyang in Henan.

units.zh: 有兄弟爭產構訟十餘年者，為據理剖解，至淚下，皆叩頭求罷，案牘遂稀。
units.en: When brothers who had litigated over property for more than ten years came before him, he reasoned through the case until they wept. They kowtowed and begged to withdraw their suit, and litigation thereafter dwindled.
units.literal: There were brothers who had litigated over property for more than ten years; he reasoned through the case until they wept, all kowtowed begging to stop, and case documents thereafter grew scarce.

units.zh: 雍正中，遷福建泉州知府，再遷興泉道參議。
units.en: During the Yongzheng reign he was transferred to prefect of Quanzhou in Fujian, then promoted to administration commissioner of the Xing-Quan Circuit.
units.literal: During Yongzheng he was transferred to prefect of Quanzhou in Fujian, then again to administration commissioner of the Xing-Quan Circuit.

units.zh: 鹽政窳敝，商居奇索高直，民苦淡食，不獲已，增價以市。
units.en: Salt administration was corrupt. Merchants hoarded salt and demanded exorbitant prices. The people, unable to obtain salt, had no choice but to pay inflated prices.
units.literal: Salt administration was corrupt and decayed; merchants hoarded and demanded high prices; the people suffered bland fare and, having no choice, paid higher prices to buy.

units.zh: 既而鹽不足，民惡其壟斷，聚而毆之。
units.en: When salt grew scarce, the people, resenting the merchants' monopoly, gathered to beat them.
units.literal: Soon salt was insufficient; the people hated their monopoly and gathered to beat them.

units.zh: 海舶私梟動逾千百，往捕則持械拒，大獄迭興，羅織牽連，數歲不息。
units.en: Private smugglers at sea often numbered over a thousand. When officials went to capture them, they resisted with weapons. Major cases arose in succession, entangling many through fabricated charges, and the turmoil continued for years.
units.literal: Private smugglers by sea often numbered over a thousand; when sent to capture them they resisted with weapons; major cases arose in succession, entangling many by fabricated charges, and for several years it did not cease.

units.zh: 而位創議裁引革商，歲額課稅歸灶完納，如農完賦，任人轉運，聽其所之，則諸弊可革而國賦不乏。
units.en: Erwei proposed abolishing salt certificates and merchant monopolies, having annual tax quotas paid at the salt works as farmers paid land tax, and allowing free transport and sale. This, he argued, would eliminate all abuses without reducing state revenue.
units.literal: Erwei innovatively proposed abolishing salt certificates and merchant monopolies, having annual quota taxes paid at the salt works like farmers paying land tax, allowing anyone to transport and sell wherever they wished—then all abuses could be reformed without shortfall in state revenue.

units.zh: 巡撫趙國麟心韙之，格於例不行。
units.en: Governor Zhao Guolin approved the plan in principle, but precedent prevented its implementation.
units.literal: Governor Zhao Guolin approved in his heart, but it was blocked by precedent and not implemented.

units.zh: 未幾，引疾歸。
units.en: Before long, he retired citing illness.
units.literal: Before long he cited illness and returned home.

units.zh: 乾隆三年，起官四川鹽茶道副使。
units.en: In the third year of Qianlong, he was recalled to serve as vice commissioner of the Sichuan Salt and Tea Circuit.
units.literal: In the third year of Qianlong he was recalled to office as vice commissioner of the Sichuan Salt and Tea Circuit.

units.zh: 蜀鹽產於井，課由井納，民便之。
units.en: Sichuan salt was produced at wells, with taxes paid at the source—a system that served the people well.
units.literal: Shu salt was produced at wells; tax was paid at the wells, and the people found it convenient.

units.zh: 雍正中有請設引招商增課者，四川鹽政自此壞。
units.en: During Yongzheng, a proposal to establish salt certificates and recruit merchant monopolies to increase revenue ruined Sichuan's salt administration.
units.literal: During Yongzheng someone requested establishing salt certificates and recruiting merchants to increase revenue; Sichuan salt administration was ruined from then on.

units.zh: 商無餘貲，運不足額，民持錢不得鹽，而井鹽滯積不售，因以致訌。
units.en: Merchants lacked capital, transport fell short of quotas, people with money could not obtain salt, and well salt piled up unsold—leading to disturbances.
units.literal: Merchants had no surplus capital, transport fell short of quota, the people held money but could not obtain salt, while well salt stagnated unsold, and thus disturbances arose.

units.zh: 而位欲事釐剔，​​大吏畏難不可，力爭，愈嫉之。
units.en: Erwei sought to reform the system, but senior officials, fearing the difficulty, refused. He argued forcefully, and they grew ever more hostile.
units.literal: Erwei wished to undertake rectification and elimination; high officials feared the difficulty and refused; he argued forcefully, and they grew ever more hostile to him.

units.zh: 改松茂道，調永寧道參議。
units.en: He was transferred to the Songmao Circuit, then to administration commissioner of the Yongning Circuit.
units.literal: He was changed to the Songmao Circuit and transferred to administration commissioner of the Yongning Circuit.

units.zh: 居常鬱鬱，不得行其志，惟與諸生講學。
units.en: Depressed at being unable to carry out his reforms, he devoted himself to lecturing scholars.
units.literal: In daily life he was depressed, unable to carry out his aims, and only lectured scholars.

units.zh: 尋卒於官。
units.en: He soon died in office.
units.literal: Soon he died in office.

units.zh: 而位生平服膺王守仁，曰：「尊所聞，行所知，須不流於弊。
units.en: Erwei devoted his life to Wang Yangming's teachings, saying, "Honor what you hear and practice what you know—but you must not drift into abuse.
units.literal: Erwei throughout his life adhered to Wang Shouren, saying: "Honor what you hear, practice what you know—you must not drift into abuse.

units.zh: 尊陽明而不知其流弊，非善學陽明；
units.en: To honor Yangming without understanding his abuses is not to study him well;
units.literal: To honor Yangming yet not know his abuses is not to study Yangming well;

units.zh: 尊硃子而不知其流弊，亦非善學硃子。」
units.en: and to honor Master Zhu without understanding his abuses is likewise not to study him well."
units.literal: to honor Master Zhu yet not know his abuses is also not to study Master Zhu well."

units.zh: 蓋謂王氏高明，弊在躐等；
units.en: He meant that Wang Yangming's teaching was lofty, but its abuse lay in skipping stages of cultivation;
units.literal: He meant that the Wang school was lofty and bright, but its abuse lay in skipping grades;

units.zh: 硃子格物，弊恐拘而不化。
units.en: while Master Zhu's investigation of things risked the abuse of rigid formalism without genuine transformation.
units.literal: Master Zhu's investigation of things feared the abuse of being constrained without transformation.

units.zh: 著省克引、劉氏家訓，為學者所稱。
units.en: He authored Introspection and Self-Restraint and the Liu Family Instructions, both praised by scholars.
units.literal: He authored Introspection and Self-Restraint and the Liu Family Instructions, praised by scholars.

units.zh: 論曰：起元深於經術，當朝政尚嚴，能持以平恕。
units.en: The commentator writes: Qi Yuan was deeply versed in the classics. When court governance favored severity, he maintained fairness and forbearance.
units.literal: The commentator says: Qi Yuan was deep in classical learning; when court governance favored severity, he was able to maintain fairness and forbearance.

units.zh: 師儉以勤敏，繼祖以明肅，並見重於時。
units.en: Shijian was valued for diligence and quickness, Jizu for clarity and severity—both were highly regarded in their time.
units.literal: Shijian for diligence and quickness, Jizu for clarity and severity—all were valued in their time.

units.zh: 維翰有幹局，甸尤能澤以儒效。
units.en: Weihan had a talent for practical administration; Dian especially enriched governance with Confucian learning.
units.literal: Weihan had capacity for affairs; Dian especially could enrich governance with Confucian effect.

units.zh: 葉滋撫循苗疆，未竟其用。
units.en: Yezi pacified the Miao frontier but died before his full potential could be realized.
units.literal: Yezi pacified and guided the Miao frontier but did not fulfill his potential.

units.zh: 而位議變鹽法，亦不得申其志，而但以學術名。
units.en: Erwei proposed reforming the salt law but likewise could not carry out his aims, and was known only for his scholarship.
units.literal: Erwei proposed changing the salt law but also could not express his aims, and was known only for learning.

units.zh: 國家重視監司，所以擴循良之績，儲封疆之選，若諸人者，可謂無忝矣。
units.en: The state values provincial commissioners to extend the achievements of worthy officials and cultivate candidates for frontier posts. Men such as these may truly be said to have lived up to that trust.
units.literal: The state values provincial commissioners in order to extend the achievements of worthy officials and store up selections for frontier posts; men such as these may be said to have been without disgrace.

units.zh: 斌篤守程、硃，亦不薄王守仁。
units.en: Bin held firmly to Cheng Yi and Zhu Xi, yet did not dismiss Wang Yangming.
units.literal: Bin devotedly upheld Cheng Yi and Zhu Xi, yet did not slight Wang Shouren.

units.zh: 八年，建賢良祠京師，諭滿洲大臣當入祀者五人，大學士圖海、都統賚塔，次即顧八代，及尚書瑪爾漢、齊蘇勒。
units.en: In year 8 the Worthy and Good Shrine was built in the capital. An edict named five Manchu ministers for enshrinement: Grand Secretary Tuhai and Commander-in-chief Ceben, then Gu Badai, and Ministers Ma Erhan and Qisuole.
units.literal: In the eighth year the Worthy and Good Shrine was built in the capital; an edict named five Manchu ministers who should be enshrined—Grand Secretary Tuhai and Commander-in-chief Ceben, next Gu Badai, and Ministers Ma Erhan and Qisuole.

units.zh: 江南總督噶禮、江蘇巡撫張伯行互訐，命尚書張鵬翮、總督赫壽按治，議奪伯行官。
units.en: Jiangnan governor-general Gali and Jiangsu governor Zhang Boxing impeached each other. ministers Zhang Penghe and Governor-General Heshou were ordered to investigate. Boxing's office was proposed for stripping.
units.literal: Jiangnan governor-general Gali and Jiangsu governor Zhang Boxing impeached each other; ministers Zhang Penghe and Governor-General Heshou were ordered to investigate; Boxing's office was proposed for stripping.

units.zh: 俄，託合齊得罪，五十一年，起廷樞工部尚書。
units.en: Soon Tuoheqi fell from favor. in the fifty-first year Tingshu was recalled as minister of works.
units.literal: Soon Tuoheqi fell from favor; in the fifty-first year Tingshu was recalled as minister of works.

units.zh: 五十二年，調刑部。
units.en: During the fifty-second year he was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments.
units.literal: In the fifty-second year he was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments.

units.zh: 法海遷。二月甲子福敏左都御史。九月丙午遷。馬齊暫署。癸丑查郎阿署。
units.en: Fahai was transferred. On the jiazi day of the second month, Fumin became Left Censor-in-Chief. In the ninth month, on bingwu day, the officeholder was transferred. Maqi served temporarily in an acting capacity. On guichou day, Chalang'a served in an acting capacity.
units.literal: Fahai was transferred. On the jiazi day of the second month, Fumin: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the bingwu day of the ninth month, was transferred. Maqi served temporarily in an acting capacity. On the guichou day, Chalang'a served in an acting capacity.

units.zh: 查郎阿
units.en: Chalang'a.
units.literal: Chalang'a.

units.zh: 查郎阿四月癸卯遷。三泰左都御史。
units.en: On the guimao day of the fourth month, Chalang'a was transferred. Santai: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the guimao day of the fourth month, Chalang'a was transferred. Santai: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 雍正四年丙午
units.en: The fourth year of Yongzheng, bingwu
units.literal: Yongzheng 4, bingwu year

units.zh: 雍正五年丁未
units.en: The fifth year of Yongzheng, dingwei
units.literal: Yongzheng 5, dingwei year

units.zh: 雍正六年戊申
units.en: The sixth year of Yongzheng, wushen
units.literal: Yongzheng 6, wushen year

units.zh: 疏下九卿，上特命奪噶禮官，伯行復任。
units.en: The memorial went to the Nine Ministers. the emperor specially ordered Gali stripped of office and Boxing restored.
units.literal: The memorial went to the Nine Ministers; the emperor specially ordered Gali stripped of office and Boxing restored.

units.zh: 時尚書隆科多獲罪鞫訊，得滿保餽金交通狀，世宗諭責滿保諂隆科多、年羹堯，命毋賜卹予諡。
units.en: but at that time Minister Longkodo was convicted and interrogated, and evidence emerged of Manbao's gifts of gold and dealings with him. The Yongzheng Emperor rebuked Manbao for currying favor with Longkodo and Nian Gengyao and ordered that no posthumous pension or title be granted.
units.literal: at that time Minister Longkodo was convicted and interrogated, and evidence was obtained of Manbao's gifts of gold and dealings with him; the Yongzheng Emperor rebuked Manbao for fawning on Longkodo and Nian Gengyao and ordered that no posthumous pension or posthumous title be granted.

units.zh: 世宗允之，命大學士硃軾等為總裁，諭令於應增應減之處，再行詳加分晰，作速修完。
units.en: The Shizong approved, appointed Grand Secretary Zhu Shi and others as chief compilers, and instructed that where additions and subtractions were needed they should be analyzed in detail and the revision completed swiftly.
units.literal: The Shizong approved, appointed Grand Secretary Zhu Shi and others as chief compilers, and instructed that where additions and subtractions were needed they should again be analyzed in detail and the revision completed swiftly.

units.zh: 文晟及湖北巡撫劉殿衡、偏沅巡撫趙申喬、提督俞益謨各降罰有差。
units.en: Wencheng, Hubei governor Liu Dianheng, Pianyuan governor Zhao Shenqiao, and provincial commander Yu Yimo were each demoted or fined in varying degrees.
units.literal: Wencheng, Hubei governor Liu Dianheng, Pianyuan governor Zhao Shenqiao, and provincial commander Yu Yimo were each demoted or fined in varying degrees.

units.zh: 四十八年，進刑部尚書。
units.en: During the forty-eighth year he was advanced to minister of punishments.
units.literal: In the forty-eighth year he was advanced to minister of punishments.

units.zh: 高宗又以舊記星紀，間有疏漏，御製璣衡撫辰儀，重加測候。
units.en: Qianlong, finding gaps in older star catalogs, built the Armillary Sphere and Chronographic Instrument and remeasured the sky.
units.literal: The Gaozong Emperor again, because old star records had occasional gaps, personally made the Armillary Sphere and Chronographic Instrument and took new observations.

units.zh: 乾隆六十年以後，國史無徵，則從闕焉。
units.en: After Qianlong 60 the Veritable Records offer no material, so the account stops there.
units.literal: After Qianlong year 60 the National History has no testimony, and those years are therefore omitted.

units.zh: 今以康熙年間實測各省及諸蒙古高度、偏度，並乾隆時憲所增省分，與回疆部落、兩金川土司等，晝夜永短，節氣早晚，推得高度、偏度備列焉。
units.en: Here Kangxi surveys, Qianlong additions, Xinjiang, and Jinchuan observations yield revised polar altitudes and longitudinal offsets.
units.literal: Now from Kangxi-era actual surveys of each province and Mongol banners, plus provinces added in the Qianlong Time Constitution, together with Muslim borderland tribes and the two Jinchuan chieftaincies — day and night length, solar-term timing — heights and offsets are derived and fully listed.

units.zh: 有清統一區夏，聖聖相承。
units.en: The Qing unified China, one sage emperor following another.
units.literal: The Qing unified All-under-Heaven, sage succeeding sage.

units.zh: 迨平定回疆及兩金川，復令重度裏差，增入時憲。
units.en: After pacifying Xinjiang and the two Jinchuan campaigns, he ordered li-cha remeasured and entered into the Shixian calendar.
units.literal: When the Muslim borderlands and the Two Jinchuan were pacified, he again ordered remeasurement of li-cha and added the results to the Time Constitution calendar.

units.zh: 楊應琚，字佩之，漢軍正白旗人，廣東巡撫文乾子。
units.en: Yang Yingju, styled Peizhi, was a Bannerman of the Plain White Banner of the Han Army and the son of Wen Qian, Governor of Guangdong.
units.literal: Yang Yingju, styled Peizhi, was a Bannerman of the Plain White Banner of the Han Army; son of Wen Qian, Governor of Guangdong.

units.zh: 藻居揚州候代，有吳之黼者，以文求教，藻行，饋糟魚，受之，中途發視，得白金四百，藻畀兩淮運使硃續晫還之黼。
units.en: While Zao was staying in Yangzhou awaiting reassignment, a man named Wu Zhifu sought his instruction in literature. When Zao set out on his journey, Zhifu presented pickled fish as a gift; he accepted it, but on the road opened it and found four hundred taels of silver inside. Zao entrusted the money to the Lianghuai grain transport commissioner Zhu Xuzhe to return it to Zhifu.
units.literal: Zao was staying in Yangzhou awaiting reassignment. A certain Wu Zhifu sought instruction in literature. When Zao departed, Zhifu presented pickled fish; he accepted it, and midway opened it to look inside, finding four hundred taels of silver. Zao handed it to the Lianghuai grain transport commissioner Zhu Xuzhe to return to Zhifu.

units.zh: 乾隆初，自員外郎出為河東道，調西寧道。
units.en: In the early Qianlong years he left his post as Bureau Director to serve as Intendant of Hedong, and was later transferred to Xining Circuit.
units.literal: In early Qianlong, from Bureau Director he went out as Intendant of Hedong, then was transferred to Xining Circuit.

units.zh: 三泰三月乙酉遷。壬辰鄂爾奇左都御史。九月丁卯遷。福敏左都御史。
units.en: On the yiyou day of the third month, Santai was transferred. On the renchen day, E'erqi: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the dingmao day of the ninth month, was transferred. Fumin: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the yiyou day of the third month, Santai was transferred. On the renchen day, E'erqi: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the dingmao day of the ninth month, was transferred. Fumin: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.en: Fumin.

units.zh: 雍正九年辛亥
units.en: The ninth year of Yongzheng, xinhai
units.literal: Yongzheng 9, xinhai year

units.zh: 雍正十年壬子
units.en: The tenth year of Yongzheng, renzi
units.literal: Yongzheng 10, renzi year

units.zh: 雍正十一年癸丑
units.en: The eleventh year of Yongzheng, guichou
units.literal: Yongzheng 11, guichou year

units.zh: 雍正十二年甲寅
units.en: The twelfth year of Yongzheng, jiayin
units.literal: Yongzheng 12, jiayin year

units.zh: 雍正十三年乙卯
units.en: The thirteenth year of Yongzheng, yimao
units.literal: Yongzheng 13, yimao year

units.zh: 陳鵬年以蘇州知府署布政使，議司庫虧三十四萬，分扣官俸役食抵補，伯行諮噶禮會題，不應。
units.en: Chen Pengnian, acting treasurer as Suzhou prefect, proposed covering a 340,000-tael deficit by docking salaries and ration payments. Boxing asked Gali to co-sign the memorial; Gali refused.
units.literal: Chen Pengnian as Suzhou prefect acted as provincial treasurer and proposed that the treasury deficit of three hundred forty thousand be covered by deducting officials' salaries and runners' rations; Boxing consulted Gali for joint memorial, but he did not agree.

units.zh: 十三年正月，命如浙江會大學士高斌覆勘巡撫常安貪婪狀，未至，高斌鞫得常安實受賕，訥親與共奏，論如律。
units.en: In the first month of 1748 he was ordered to Zhejiang to join Grand Secretary Gao Bin in reinvestigating Governor Chang An; before he arrived, Gao Bin had proved Chang An's bribes, and Neqin joined the memorial; sentence followed the law.
units.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year he was ordered to Zhejiang to join Grand Secretary Gao Bin in re-investigating Governor Chang An's corruption; before his arrival Gao Bin had already obtained proof that Chang An had indeed taken bribes; Neqin joined in the memorial; judgment was according to law.
